labels.notes: Lean >= target. Every one of the target's nine assertions is a conjunct, and 13 more are added (22 in all). They decide the ladder's 20 causality-sort nodes: 18 hold, causally_arc_connected and absolutely_minimal fail, and the hereditary ¬ ∀ W, AbsolutelyMinimalOn W is added. A run_cmd probe read the conjunct heads off the elaborated type. Each conjunct is the ladder's own [[property]] `lean`: Causal.Causality.{GloballyHyperbolic, Tarentin, IsCausal, CausallyCompact, StronglyCausal, HasTimeFunction, CurvesExtend, StronglyCausalOpen, PushUp, LocallyPushUp, CausallyOpen, CausallyOpenFuture, LocallyCausallyOpenFuture, LocallyCausallyOpen, CausallyPlain, ChronalNeighbours, HasChronalNeighbourEverywhere, FutureOneConnected, CausallyArcConnected} and Causal.Precausality.AbsolutelyMinimal (through Causality.toPrecausality). The negations are kernel-checked refutations, and they hold for the right reason. ¬ CausallyArcConnected: 0 ≤ 1 in gapSet = ]-1/4,1/4[ ∪ ]1/2,5/4[, but the causal curves are the timelike line's. ¬ AbsolutelyMinimal: GluingModels.densCausality_not_minimal, on the same set. I checked the three new facts against the definition (SubExtensionAbstract.lean:213). PushUp holds by dens_add: ≪ followed by ≤, or the reverse, adds a strict and a non-strict density inequality. ChronalNeighbours holds because a small interval inside V has full density. FutureOneConnected holds because on a convex open N' the dens relation is the timelike one, so the chronal curves are the timelike line's, and timelikeLine_futureOneConnectedOn applies. It is NOT vacuous. densCausality is chronological (≪_U needs x < y). In an audit probe, id and t ↦ t² are both chronal curves of ⊤ from 0 to 1, so the homotopy is really asked for. This is unlike the jump and rational lines (no chronology, vacuous). No ** mark on an ETT label. The **`Causal.densCausality_separates`** in the docstring does not match ledger.py's docstring_label_re, which needs a label prefix with a colon. This follows the precedent of IsolatedLineConjoined.lean:27.

labels.label: (helpers) Causal.DensWitness.densCausality_lt_of_timelike, densCausality_pushUp, chronalNeighbours_of_timelike, chronalCurveOn_iff_timelike, futureOneConnectedOn_of_timelike
labels.notes: The hypotheses are stated accurately. chronalNeighbours_of_timelike uses only hsub (timelikeLine.lt → D.lt), and its docstring says 'containing the timelike line's chronology'. chronalCurveOn_iff_timelike and futureOneConnectedOn_of_timelike use hup (D.lt U x y → x < y, '≪ goes up') and hsub. The forward direction of the iff is sound: it applies h.rel at the convex N' = Ioo l u ⊆ N, then gets Icc (c s) (c s') ⊆ Ioo l u ⊆ N. The backward direction is hsub. The kb proposal's extension to bigCausality and every IsMid D also checks: lt_big gives x < y, and lt_of_dens composed with densCausality_lt_of_timelike gives hsub. The generic lemmas live in namespace DensWitness, beside the existing generic causalCurveOn_iff_timelike (precedent; hoisting them is optional).

checks.keeper_finding: Checked, anchored by (from, to). All three [[open]] entries exist: chronal_neighbours → absolutely_minimal, future_one_connected → absolutely_minimal and future_one_connected → causally_arc_connected. Their current lines (4882–4885, about 5051 and 5056) match the REPORT. The REPORT's qualification is correct. Causal.jumpLine_separates_futureOneConnected (FutureOneConnectedVacuous.lean:303) conjoins FutureOneConnected with ¬ AbsolutelyMinimal. Causal.rationalLine_separates_futureOneConnected (:219) conjoins FutureOneConnected, AbsolutelyMinimal and ¬ CausallyArcConnected. Once those are recorded, the 18-node entry adds only chronal_neighbours → absolutely_minimal. Grep for _chronalNeighbours facts finds only absolutely minimal carriers: timelikeLine, chronalMembrane, rationalJumpPlane, timeCylinder, spaceCylinder, cosmicString/massive, static. So densCausality is the first Lean witness of that pair, in the no-gluing reading only, as the closer says. Also confirmed: GH → causally_arc_connected is refuted on the ladder only by the gated and jump lines, tarentin → causally_arc_connected by the global line and the rational-jump plane, and no recorded counterexample has both globally_hyperbolic and tarentin while lacking causally_arc_connected or absolutely_minimal (the 5 entries with both, lightlike ×3 and half-chronological ×2, lack neither).

findings.what: The SCOPE says without qualification that the 18-node entry to absolutely_minimal 'settles three [[open]] pairs' (chronal_neighbours → absolutely_minimal, future_one_connected → absolutely_minimal, future_one_connected → causally_arc_connected). That is true of the ladder as it stands on disk (20:57 UTC), but the keeper is now recording T-abs-future-one-connected-vacuous's witnesses. Causal.jumpLine_separates_futureOneConnected and Causal.rationalLine_separates_futureOneConnected already settle the last two, the latter in either reading. After that recording, only chronal_neighbours → absolutely_minimal moves. REPORT.json says this (lemmas_for_the_keeper[1].note), but the module docstring, which is the permanent contract, does not.
findings.fix: At graduation, or in a follow-up, date the simulation and qualify it. For example: 'Simulated on the ladder of 2026-11-27 … settles three [[open]] pairs; two of them are also refuted by T-abs-future-one-connected-vacuous's witnesses (vacuously, by chronology-free lines), so the pair new to Lean is chronal_neighbours → absolutely_minimal.' A related point worth adding: densCausality is the first NON-vacuous witness of future_one_connected ⇏ causally_arc_connected and ⇏ absolutely_minimal. It is chronological and has chronal curves, where the jump and rational lines have none.
